individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial deconvolution heatmap overlay where every spot already represents an individual data point; comparable to a heatmap, which is exempt.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Spatial heatmap overlay with no error bars or summary statistics requiring definition.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plot (with overlaid individual points visible) is exempt from this requirement as it already shows the data distribution.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; T11b-high LUSC: Classical monocyte (minima=0.00035, median=0.32265, maxima=1, Q1 = 0.16193, Q3 = 0.52806)...
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot whiskers and quartiles are explicitly defined in the caption with exact percentile, median, minima and maxima values for every group.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment score line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: GSEA enrichment plots show a single running-score curve with NES, FDR and P values annotated; no error bars are present.

individual-data-points.explanation: Each bar is a single derived log2 fold-change statistic from a large-scale DEG analysis with an associated p-value, not a mean of discrete replicate measurements that could be overlaid as points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Bar graph of log2 fold change per gene with p-values annotated above bars; no error bars are displayed.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E consists of representative H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel E is a set of representative micrographs, not a plot, so this check does not apply.
